In the trigger, compare Trigger.oldMap.get(o.Id).StageName with o.StageName to find deals that just became Closed Won. Enqueue once, after the loop, only if the set isn't empty.
In execute, query Id, Name and Amount for the Ids, build a list of small maps or wrapper objects, and JSON.serialize it into the request body.
Make the callout first, then update NextStep on all the queried records in one DML. A Queueable that implements Database.AllowsCallouts may call out; the trigger itself may not.
